The additional amount will be equal to the average balance in the account during the period of 36 months preceding the month of death, subject to a maximum of~ 60,000 in the case of GPF subscribers and t 30,000 for CPF. The maximum limit is to be applied after arriving at the average of 36 months and not at every stage.
3. The balance for March every year and for the last month of the three-year period will be inclusive of interest.
